subject: english-grammar
descEn: Eight original bilingual questions covering agreement, tense, articles, prepositions, voice, conditionals, usage and vocabulary.
descHi: वाक्य-सामंजस्य, काल, आर्टिकल, संबंधसूचक शब्द, वाच्य, शर्तीय वाक्य, प्रयोग और शब्दावली पर आठ मौलिक द्विभाषी प्रश्न।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Neither of the two proposals ___ acceptable.
questions.questionHi: दोनों प्रस्तावों में से कोई भी स्वीकार्य नहीं ___।
questions.explanationEn: “Neither” is singular in this construction, so it takes “is.”
questions.explanationHi: इस वाक्य-रचना में “Neither” एकवचन है, इसलिए “is” सही है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionHi: वह 2021 ___ यहाँ काम कर रही है।
questions.explanationEn: Use “since” with a specific starting point in time.
questions.explanationHi: समय के निश्चित आरंभ-बिंदु के साथ “since” का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct article: She is ___ honest officer.
questions.questionHi: सही आर्टिकल चुनें: She is ___ honest officer.
questions.explanationEn: “Honest” begins with a vowel sound because its “h” is silent, so “an” is used.
questions.explanationHi: “Honest” में h का उच्चारण नहीं होता और शब्द स्वर-ध्वनि से शुरू होता है, इसलिए “an” आएगा।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.explanationEn: Use “on” with days of the week.
questions.explanationHi: सप्ताह के दिनों के साथ “on” का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct passive form of: “The clerk filed the report yesterday.”
questions.questionHi: “The clerk filed the report yesterday.” का सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें।
optionsEn: The report is filed by the clerk yesterday.
The report has filed by the clerk yesterday.
The report was filed by the clerk yesterday.
The report had been file by the clerk yesterday.
optionsHi: The report is filed by the clerk yesterday.
The report has filed by the clerk yesterday.
The report was filed by the clerk yesterday.
The report had been file by the clerk yesterday.
questions.explanationEn: Simple past active changes to “was/were + past participle” in the passive.
questions.explanationHi: सामान्य भूतकाल के कर्मवाच्य में “was/were + past participle” आता है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: If I ___ more time, I would learn another language.
questions.questionHi: यदि मेरे पास अधिक समय ___, तो मैं एक और भाषा सीखता।
questions.explanationEn: The second conditional uses the past form in the if-clause: “If I had…, I would…”.
questions.explanationHi: द्वितीय शर्तीय वाक्य में if-clause के साथ past form आता है: “If I had…, I would…”.

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionHi: व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही वाक्य चुनें।
optionsEn: Each of the students have submitted the form.
Each of the students has submitted the form.
Each of the students are submitting the form.
Each students has submitted the form.
optionsHi: Each of the students have submitted the form.
Each of the students has submitted the form.
Each of the students are submitting the form.
Each students has submitted the form.
questions.explanationEn: “Each” is singular and takes the singular verb “has.”
questions.explanationHi: “Each” एकवचन है, इसलिए इसके साथ एकवचन क्रिया “has” आती है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Which word is closest in meaning to “meticulous”?
questions.questionHi: “Meticulous” शब्द का सबसे निकट अर्थ कौन-सा है?
questions.explanationEn: “Meticulous” means showing great attention to detail.
questions.explanationHi: “Meticulous” का अर्थ है बारीकियों पर बहुत ध्यान देने वाला।
